name: connectpak-cassandra
description: Read-only Cassandra access for AI agents over MCP: list schemas, describe tables, sample rows, and run guarded queries.

interface.longDescription: Read-only Cassandra access for AI agents over MCP: list schemas, describe tables, sample rows, and run guarded queries. Set $CONNECTPAK_CASSANDRA_HOSTS in your environment before starting Codex. Writes are rejected by a parser guard and by the engine's own read-only mode; every query has a timeout and a row cap.
defaultPrompt: What tables are in my Cassandra database?
